findings.why: The phone number in the post does not match the ficha phone (512) 555-0142, and it also contradicts the JSON-LD telephone.

The internal link points to a page that is not in the ficha; the existing page is /services/cleanings-exams only as listed, but the post path is /services/cleanings-exams while the ficha lists /services/cleanings-exams exactly, so verify; if the live URL differs it is broken.
findings.fix: Confirm the link resolves to /services/cleanings-exams on the live site.

findings.why: This URL looks fabricated (a 'treatment-guidelines-2026' slug) and I cannot verify that it exists or supports the claim.
findings.fix: Replace with a verified NIDCR gum disease page URL or remove the link.

findings.quote: We are in network with Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife
findings.why: The carriers match the ficha's accepted insurance, but 'in network' is stronger wording than 'accepted' and is not stated in the ficha.
findings.fix: Use 'we accept Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife' to match the ficha.

findings.quote: In today's fast-paced world, maintaining a healthy smile is more important than ever. Let's delve into how often you should really see the dentist.
findings.why: Generic filler opener and the stock phrase 'delve into' are typical AI tells.
findings.fix: Delete the opener and start with the direct answer about the six-month interval.

findings.quote: Tartar builds up on a timeline that is similar for most people
findings.why: Tartar buildup varies considerably between people, so this is an unsupported and likely inaccurate generalization.
findings.fix: Say that buildup varies by person and cite ADA or NIDCR guidance, or remove the sentence.

findings.quote: six months is long enough to see changes but short enough to catch a small problem before it grows
findings.why: The rationale for the six-month interval is presented as fact without a source.
findings.fix: Cite ADA guidance or soften to say that many dentists recommend about every six months.

findings.quote: Your dentist may suggest visits every three or four months if you have any of these:
findings.why: The specific three-to-four-month interval and risk factors are not backed by a source in the post.
findings.fix: Link a verified ADA or NIDCR source or say the interval is set by the dentist based on individual risk.

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental is a fictional practice created for a software demonstration. This post is sample content.
findings.why: Demo or disclaimer text would be inappropriate in a published post.
findings.fix: Remove the disclaimer before real publication.

findings.why: The JSON-LD phone matches the ficha but contradicts the visible phone number in the post body.
findings.fix: Correct the visible phone to (512) 555-0142 so text and schema agree.

findings.why: The schema lacks the reviewer (Dr. Elena Marsh) shown in the front matter and has no address, so it is less complete than the visible content.
findings.fix: Add a reviewedBy property and the publisher address that match the ficha.
